newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China EB Tech off after trading resumes.
newsitem.headline: China EB Tech off after trading resumes.

text.p: Shares of China Everbright Technology Ltd tumbled on Wednesday after the company said it was not aware of any talks or agreement relating to a possible purchase of Hong Kong Telecommunications Ltd shares.
China Everbright Technology shares were off HK$0.27 at HK$1.62. Trading in the stock was suspended on Tuesday.
"It's profit-taking since the stock rose sharply after news that its parent had agreed to buy Telecom shares," said Michael Ng, dealing director at Sassoon Securities.
Hongkong Telecom shares were down HK$0.10 at HK$15.10.
CITIC Pacific Ltd said last Friday it had agreed in principle to sell its 7.74 percent stake in Hongkong Telecom to a subsidiary of China Everbright Holdings Co Ltd.
The announcement sparked speculation China Everbright Holdings, which is backed by China's State Council, would inject the stake into China Everbright Technology.
China Everbright Holdings has two other Hong Kong-listed subsidiaries -- China Everbright International Ltd and China Everbright-IHD Pacific Ltd.
China Everbright International was down HK$0.09 at HK$1.75 and China Everbright-IHD fell HK$0.20 to HK$8.80.
